entities.name: Erythronate-4-phosphate dehydrogenase
observations: The 387-aa query sequence is an exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt entry B1KKP1 from Shewanella woodyi.
The enzyme is annotated as cytoplasmic and homodimeric.
Pfam evidence identifies the 2-Hacid_dh catalytic domain (PF00389), 2-Hacid_dh_C domain (PF02826), and a C-terminal DUF3410 region.

entities.name: 4-phospho-D-erythronate oxidation
observations: The reaction is assigned EC 1.1.1.290 and Rhea RHEA:18829.
This oxidation is step 2 of 5 in pyridoxine 5'-phosphate biosynthesis from D-erythrose 4-phosphate.

entities.name: Pyridoxine 5-phosphate biosynthesis
observations: Erythronate-4-phosphate dehydrogenase performs the second step in the pathway from D-erythrose 4-phosphate to pyridoxine 5'-phosphate.
